value.rationale: The two-block cube free sum is a canonical infinite family of unconditional Hanner polytopes, with intrinsic Euclidean block maxima. It exhibits a genuine threshold: the conditioned squared radial energy changes scale from N^-1/2 to N^-1 and has a full noncentral quadratic-Gaussian minus exponential window, while the unconditioned energy remains Gaussian. This sharp distinction reveals radial geometry invisible to covariance-only and ordinary CLT formulas; not a parameter substitution or arbitrary finite numerical slice.
